newsitem.title: ITALY: Snia BPD Q1 pretax profit 21 billion lire.
newsitem.headline: Snia BPD Q1 pretax profit 21 billion lire.

text.p: Italian holding company Snia BPD on Wednesday reported a pretax profit in the first quarter of 1997 of 21 billion lire compared to 35 billion lire after an extraordinary charge of 10 billion lire.
First quarter 1997 operating profits fell to 36.4 billion lire from 42 billion lire in the first three months of 1997 on sales of 764 billion lire from 781 billion lire.
The group said in a statement that first quarter figures were affected by the high value of the lira and the sell-off of some of the activities of Sorin, in which Snia BPD has a controlling stake.
